snippet.title: Dracula: The Disciple | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Descend into the cursed halls of Count Dracula’s castle in Dracula: The Disciple, a first-person puzzle adventure where occult knowledge is your only path to immortality.

Play as Emile Valombres, a dying French archivist drawn to Dracula’s abandoned stronghold in search of a cure. Explore a Gothic castle filled with mystical puzzles, forbidden experiments, alchemical secrets and dark rituals left behind by the Count himself.

Master occult tools, grow supernatural ingredients, perform ancient rites and uncover the truth behind vampiric transformation. But salvation comes at a terrible price… To cheat death, you must become something else.

🩸 Solve intricate supernatural puzzles
⚗️ Practice alchemy and occult experimentation
🦇 Embrace vampiric powers to unlock new paths
🏰 Explore Dracula’s haunting castle and uncover its secrets

Will you escape death… or become the next master of the castle?

Wishlist Dracula: The Disciple now and follow for more dark revelations: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3474240/Dracula_The_Disciple/
